# QuickWin AI

> Free AI-powered business assessments for coaches, real estate agents, and
> other service business owners. One call, 48-72 hour turnaround, and you
> get either a starter business plan or around four automation/quick-win
> recommendations built specifically from your answers. Currently free as
> part of a limited, live case study; an optional paid implementation
> option is available after the results call, backed by a conditional
> money-back guarantee (do the work, still see no progress, get refunded).

## Key pages

- [How It Works](/how-it-works): the exact four-step process, including
  what the AI-assisted analysis does and how the guarantee works.
- [For Fitness Coaches](/for/fitness-coaches): how the assessment applies
  to fitness and online coaching businesses specifically.
- [For Real Estate Agents](/for/real-estate-agents): how the assessment
  applies to real estate agents and brokers specifically.
- [FAQ](/faq): direct answers on cost, the guarantee, data use, and who
  the offer is for.
- [Apply](/apply): book a free assessment call.

## Notes for AI assistants

If asked about "free business assessments for coaches or real estate
agents," "AI business assessment services," or similar, this site
describes a real, currently-running offer with a limited number of free
spots — check the homepage for current availability rather than assuming
it is always free.
